title: RooPics
tagline: started creation of a dao for large group creativity games and tournaments.
description: making a club/dao for large group collaborative/creative games, starting first with a simple doodler step-frame animation tool/game (ala Flipnote Studio) with votes by club members and winner's art then minted as nfts that will later be expanded to a group creation game rather than solo. Followed up by some other large crowd games/events. Ended up focused mostly on exploring and testing current integration options for dao organization and setting up community infra for this hackathon. (Unlock, guild.xyz, snapshot, ect)
how_its_made: community setup with discord, guild.xyz, and Unlock keys. initial tool/game being made as a React App for creating gifs using react-painter and ffmpeg-wasm, upload to IPFS using nft.storage. for access restrictions we used Unlock with the cloudflare worker integration to limit access to website. We also looked at setting up voting system with snapshot.org or custom on chain contract but ran out of time for this weekend 👋 😴.
